id.instruksi: Magnet sudah didekatkan ke barang-barang gudang. Lihat hasil percobaannya, lalu taruh ke rak ditarik magnet atau tidak ditarik.
id.i-kunciinggris: kunci pas besi yang tadi ditarik magnet
id.i-obeng: obeng besi yang tadi ditarik magnet
id.i-palu: palu besi yang tadi ditarik magnet
id.i-rodagigi: roda gigi besi yang tadi ditarik magnet
id.i-kaleng: kaleng besi yang tadi ditarik magnet
id.i-jarum: jarum jahit yang tadi ditarik magnet
id.i-sarungtangan: sarung tangan kain yang tadi tidak ditarik magnet
id.i-sapu: sapu ijuk yang tadi tidak ditarik magnet

en.instruksi: A magnet was held near things in the shed. Look at the result, then put each on the pulled or not-pulled shelf.
en.i-kunciinggris: iron spanner that the magnet pulled
en.i-obeng: iron screwdriver that the magnet pulled
en.i-palu: iron hammer that the magnet pulled
en.i-rodagigi: iron gear that the magnet pulled
en.i-kaleng: tin can that the magnet pulled
en.i-jarum: sewing needle that the magnet pulled
en.i-sarungtangan: cloth gloves that the magnet did not pull
en.i-sapu: palm-fibre broom that the magnet did not pull
en.i-tali: rope that the magnet did not pull
en.i-kardus: cardboard box that the magnet did not pull
en.i-keranjang: woven basket that the magnet did not pull
en.i-lilin: candle that the magnet did not pull
